item.title: Pocket ID vs Tinyauth vs Hanko in 2026: Self-Hosted Auth Without Keycloak's Bloat
item.description: Keycloak is a masterpiece of scope creep. A default deployment wants a database, a JVM tuned for hundreds of megabytes of heap, a realm model you have to learn before you can add a single user, and an upgrade path that historically broke custom themes twice a year. For a homelab with six services and four users, it is a two-tonne truck used to buy groceries.
